newsitem.title: USA: U.S. copper center shipments in 1996 barely higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. copper center shipments in 1996 barely higher.

text.p: Shipments of copper and brass products from U.S. service centers rose just 0.3 percent in 1996 over the previous year, the Copper and Brass Servicenter Association reported.
Copper products shipments in 1996 rose five percent, while alloy shipments fell 1.7 percent compared to 1995.
December's total shipments of copper and copper alloy products fell 10.5 percent from November, and the average daily shipping rate was down 8.6 percent.
The CBSA said December's dip was due to seasonal factors but was less than in the same month in 1995.
Inventory levels at the end of December were up 1.8 percent for all copper products compared to year-end 1995, and down two percent for all alloy products.
